name: swaggymusic-github-bot
description: SWAGGYMUSIC GitHub Controller Bot — a Telegram bot that manages GitHub repositories, issues, pull requests, GitHub Actions, releases, discussions, and webhooks directly from Telegram. Features AES-256-GCM encrypted token storage, per-event notification settings, GraphQL API support (pin/unpin, draft/ready, discussions), and secure webhook signature verification.

BOT_OWNER_IDS.description: Comma-separated Telegram user IDs that own this bot instance. Owners can use server-level credentials and reload admin caches. Get your ID from @userinfobot.

MONGODB_URI.description: External MongoDB connection string. Use MongoDB Atlas (https://www.mongodb.com/atlas). Example: mongodb+srv://user:pass@cluster.mongodb.net/db?retryWrites=true&w=majority. The bot does NOT run MongoDB inside the dyno.

MONGODB_DATABASE.description: MongoDB database name. Defaults to swaggymusic_github_bot if left empty, but must be set explicitly for Heroku.

GITHUB_API_URL.description: GitHub API URL. Use https://api.github.com for github.com. For GitHub Enterprise Server, set to https://YOUR-HOST/api/v3.

GITHUB_CLIENT_ID.description: GitHub OAuth App Client ID from https://github.com/settings/developers. Required only if using OAuth (PAT-only mode works without it).

GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET.description: GitHub OAuth App Client Secret. Required only if GITHUB_CLIENT_ID is set.

GITHUB_OAUTH_CALLBACK_URL.description: GitHub OAuth callback URL. Must be https://YOUR-APP-NAME.herokuapp.com/oauth/callback. Set this AFTER creating the app, using your Heroku app URL.

GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: Shared secret used to validate incoming GitHub webhook payloads. A strong random value is generated automatically.

ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: 32-byte (64 hex characters) AES-256-GCM key used to encrypt stored GitHub tokens at rest. A strong random value is generated automatically. WARNING: if this key is lost or changed, all previously encrypted tokens become unrecoverable.

SESSION_SECRET.description: Random secret used to sign session cookies and OAuth state tokens. A strong random value is generated automatically.

PUBLIC_BASE_URL.description: Public HTTPS URL of this Heroku app (no trailing slash). Used for GitHub OAuth callback and webhook URLs. Set this to https://YOUR-APP-NAME.herokuapp.com AFTER the app is created, then restart the dyno. The app will fail to start without this set.

LOG_LEVEL.description: Logging verbosity. One of: debug, info, warn, error. Use info or warn in production to avoid leaking debug details.
